  (w : NumberField.InfinitePlace K) (μ : Measure (MasulloGRH.HeckeIdeleClasses K)) [μ.IsMulLeftInvariant]
  [IsFiniteMeasureOnCompacts μ] (hμ : μ Set.univ ≠ 0) (α : ℝ) (d : ℕ) (χ : MasulloGRH.UnitaryHeckeCharacter K) (z : ℂ)
  (m : ℕ) (hstrip : |z.re| ≤ α) (hmd : m < d)
  (hmeas :
    AEStronglyMeasurable (fun x => MasulloGRH.genuineSpectralJet K χ z m x / ↑√(MasulloGRH.genuineStripWeight K α d x))
      μ) :
  ∃ V,
    0 < V ∧
      μ (MasulloGRH.genuineClassLogReal K ⁻¹' Set.Ioc 0 1) = ↑V ∧
        ∃ v,
          (∀ (F : ↥(Lp ℂ 2 μ)),
              inner ℂ v F =
                ∫ (x : MasulloGRH.HeckeIdeleClasses K),
                  MasulloGRH.genuineSpectralJet K χ z m x / ↑√(MasulloGRH.genuineStripWeight K α d x) * ↑↑F x ∂μ) ∧
            ‖v‖ ^ 2 ≤ ↑V * Real.pi ∧
              ∀ (A : ↥(Lp ℂ 2 μ) →L[ℂ] ↥(Lp ℂ 2 μ)) (r : ↥(Lp ℂ 2 μ)),
                ‖A (Round93H.canonicalLift r)‖ * ‖(innerSL ℂ) v‖ = ‖A r‖ * ‖v‖ / ‖r‖ ^ 2

      μ (genuineClassLogReal K ⁻¹' Set.Ioc 0 1) = ↑V ∧
        ∃ v,
          (∀ (F : ↥(Lp ℂ 2 μ)),

Round96H.genuine_allLabel_residual_energy.{u_1, u_2} (K : Type u_1) [Field K] [NumberField K]
  (w : NumberField.InfinitePlace K) (μ : Measure (HeckeIdeleClasses K)) [μ.IsMulLeftInvariant]
  [IsFiniteMeasureOnCompacts μ] (hμ : μ Set.univ ≠ 0) (α : ℝ) (d : ℕ) {ι : Type u_2} (χ : ι → UnitaryHeckeCharacter K)
  (z : ι → ℂ) (m : ι → ℕ) (hstrip : ∀ (i : ι), |(z i).re| ≤ α) (hmd : ∀ (i : ι), m i < d)
  (hmeas :
    ∀ (i : ι),
      AEStronglyMeasurable (fun x => genuineSpectralJet K (χ i) (z i) (m i) x / ↑√(genuineStripWeight K α d x)) μ) :
  ∃ v,
    (∀ (i : ι) (F : ↥(Lp ℂ 2 μ)),
        inner ℂ (v i) F =
          ∫ (x : HeckeIdeleClasses K),
            genuineSpectralJet K (χ i) (z i) (m i) x / ↑√(genuineStripWeight K α d x) * ↑↑F x ∂μ) ∧
      ∀ (i j : ι),
        j ≠ i →
          ‖orthogonalResidual (otherCoefficientSpace v i) (v i)‖ ^ 2 ≤
            ∫ (x : HeckeIdeleClasses K),
              ‖genuineSpectralJet K (χ i) (z i) (m i) x / ↑√(genuineStripWeight K α d x) -
                    genuineSpectralJet K (χ j) (z j) (m j) x / ↑√(genuineStripWeight K α d x)‖ ^
                2 ∂μ

Round97H.genuine_rational_mass_and_tail.{u_1} (K : Type u_1) [Field K] [NumberField K] (w : NumberField.InfinitePlace K)
  (μ : Measure (HeckeIdeleClasses K)) [μ.IsMulLeftInvariant] [IsFiniteMeasureOnCompacts μ] (hμ : μ Set.univ ≠ 0) :
  ∃ V,
    0 < V ∧
      μ (genuineClassLogReal K ⁻¹' Set.Ioc 0 1) = ↑V ∧
        Integrable (fun x => (1 + genuineClassLogReal K x ^ 2)⁻¹) μ ∧
          ∫ (x : HeckeIdeleClasses K), (1 + genuineClassLogReal K x ^ 2)⁻¹ ∂μ = ↑V * Real.pi ∧
            ∀ (R : ℝ),
              0 ≤ R →
                ∫ (x : HeckeIdeleClasses K),
                    (Set.Icc (-R) R)ᶜ.indicator (fun t => (1 + t ^ 2)⁻¹) (genuineClassLogReal K x) ∂μ =
                  ↑V * (Real.pi - 2 * Real.arctan R)

Round97H.genuine_cutoff_rational_energy_bound.{u_1} (K : Type u_1) [Field K] [NumberField K]
  (w : NumberField.InfinitePlace K) (μ : Measure (HeckeIdeleClasses K)) [μ.IsMulLeftInvariant]
  [IsFiniteMeasureOnCompacts μ] (hμ : μ Set.univ ≠ 0) :
  ∃ V,
    0 < V ∧
      ∀ (R : ℝ) (ρ : HeckeIdeleClasses K → ℂ),
        0 ≤ R →
          AEStronglyMeasurable ρ μ →
            (∀ (x : HeckeIdeleClasses K), ‖ρ x‖ ≤ 1) →
              (∀ (x : HeckeIdeleClasses K), genuineClassLogReal K x ∈ Set.Icc (-R) R → ρ x = 1) →
                Integrable (fun x => ‖ρ x - 1‖ ^ 2 * (1 + genuineClassLogReal K x ^ 2)⁻¹) μ ∧
                  ∫ (x : HeckeIdeleClasses K), ‖ρ x - 1‖ ^ 2 * (1 + genuineClassLogReal K x ^ 2)⁻¹ ∂μ ≤
                    4 * ↑V * (Real.pi - 2 * Real.arctan R)

Round97H.genuine_residual_cutoff_cost_tendsto_zero.{u_1} (K : Type u_1) [Field K] [NumberField K]
  (w : NumberField.InfinitePlace K) (μ : Measure (HeckeIdeleClasses K)) [μ.IsMulLeftInvariant]
  [IsFiniteMeasureOnCompacts μ] (hμ : μ Set.univ ≠ 0) (ρ : ℕ → HeckeIdeleClasses K → ℂ)
  (hb : ∀ (n : ℕ) (x : HeckeIdeleClasses K), ‖ρ n x‖ ≤ 1) (hm : ∀ (n : ℕ), AEStronglyMeasurable (ρ n) μ)
  (hl : ∀ᵐ (x : HeckeIdeleClasses K) ∂μ, Tendsto (fun n => ρ n x) atTop (nhds 1)) (C : ℝ) :
  Tendsto (fun n => √(∫ (x : HeckeIdeleClasses K), ‖ρ n x - 1‖ ^ 2 * (1 + genuineClassLogReal K x ^ 2)⁻¹ ∂μ) * C) atTop
    (nhds 0)
